title: Never have I seen — olumsuz devrik yapı
canDo: Yazılı ve retorik dilde vurguyu cümle düzeniyle kurabilirim.

concept.summary: Olumsuz ya da neredeyse olumsuz bir zarf cümlenin başına alınırsa, arkasından soru düzeni gelir: özne ile yardımcı fiil yer değiştirir. Bu bir üslup seçimidir; anlam aynı kalır, vurgu artar. Yardımcı fiil yoksa do/does/did getirilir. Yapı yazıya ve resmî konuşmaya özgüdür; günlük dilde kullanılırsa abartılı durur.

table.example: Never have I heard such a thing.
Rarely does a film do this.
Hardly had we left when it began.
No sooner had she spoken than …

examples.en: Never have I heard such a weak argument.
examples.tr: Hayatımda bu kadar zayıf bir sav duymadım.

examples.en: Rarely does a film divide critics so sharply.
examples.tr: Bir film eleştirmenleri nadiren bu kadar keskin böler.

examples.en: Hardly had we left when the storm began.
No sooner had she spoken than the room fell silent.
examples.note: No sooner … than; as değil than.

examples.en: Under no circumstances should the door be left open.
examples.note: Olumsuz öbek de devrik düzen ister.

mistakes.wrong: Never I have seen such a mess.
mistakes.right: Never have I seen such a mess.
mistakes.why: Olumsuz zarf başa gelince soru düzeni gerekir.

mistakes.wrong: No sooner had he left when it started to rain.
mistakes.right: No sooner had he left than it started to rain.
mistakes.why: No sooner than ile eşlenir; when ile değil.

mistakes.wrong: Rarely a film divides critics so sharply.
mistakes.right: Rarely does a film divide critics so sharply.
mistakes.why: Yardımcı fiil yoksa does getirilir.

exercises.text: Never ___ such a badly written report.
Rarely ___ an offer this good.
No sooner had the meeting started ___ the power went off.
Hardly had we sat down ___ the phone rang.
Under no circumstances ___ leave the building unlocked.
Seldom ___ a decision been taken so quickly.
Not until the third week ___ the mistake.

In which kind of writing does this order belong? It belongs in ___ .
exercises.note: Devrik düzen yazılı ve resmî dile özgüdür.

exercises.text: Only after the audit ___ the size of the loss.

title: So do I — kısa onay ve So + sıfat devriği
canDo: Bir görüşe katıldığımı ya da katılmadığımı tek kısa cümleyle bildirebilirim.

concept.summary: Bir cümleye katıldığını söylemenin kısa yolu so ya da neither ile başlayıp yardımcı fiili özneden önce koymaktır: So do I, Neither can she. Olumlu cümleye so, olumsuz cümleye neither ya da nor gelir. Aynı devrik düzen So + sıfat + be + özne kalıbında da görülür ve derece vurgular: So great was the damage that … Dikkat: So I do farklı bir anlam taşır, onay değil doğrulamadır.

table.example: I like it. — So do I.
I don't like it. — Neither do I.
They have finished. — So have we.
So great was the damage that …

examples.en: I can't stand the noise. — Neither can I.
She works in the same building. — So do I.
They have already voted. — So have we.
So great was the damage that the road stayed closed for a year.
examples.tr: Hasar öyle büyüktü ki yol bir yıl kapalı kaldı.

examples.en: He didn't apply, and nor did his brother.
examples.note: nor, neither ile aynı işi görür.

mistakes.wrong: I love it. — So I do.
mistakes.right: I love it. — So do I.
mistakes.why: Onayda devrik düzen kullanılır; "So I do" farklı bir anlam taşır.

mistakes.wrong: I can't swim. — So can't I.
mistakes.right: I can't swim. — Neither can I.
mistakes.why: Olumsuz cümleye neither ya da nor gelir.

mistakes.wrong: Neither I can see it.
mistakes.right: Neither can I see it.
mistakes.why: neither'dan sonra yardımcı fiil özneden önce gelir.

exercises.text: I have already eaten. — ___ .
She doesn't drive. — ___ .
They were late. — ___ .
He can't come on Friday, ___ can his wife.
So ___ the crowd that the doors had to be closed.
I went home early. — ___ .
We hadn't been told. — ___ .
She is not on the list, ___ am I.
So ___ the noise that nobody could hear the speaker.
I would never sign that. — ___ .

title: hardly, scarcely, seldom — biçimce olumlu, anlamca olumsuz
canDo: Olumsuzluğu doğrudan söylemeden, derecesini ayarlayarak kurabilirim.

concept.summary: Bu zarflar biçimce olumlu ama anlamca olumsuzdur: hardly "neredeyse hiç", seldom "pek seyrek" demektir. Olumsuzluğu kendileri taşıdıkları için cümlede ikinci bir olumsuz almazlar; bu Türkçe konuşan öğrencinin en sık düştüğü tuzaktır, çünkü Türkçede olumsuzluk fiile de yansır. Soru eklerinde de olumlu biçim gelir: He hardly ever calls, does he?

table.example: There is hardly any milk left.
He hardly ever answers.
She seldom speaks at meetings.
I could barely hear him.

examples.en: There is hardly any milk left.
He hardly ever answers his phone.
She seldom speaks at meetings.
I could barely understand his accent.
Scarcely anyone noticed the change.

mistakes.wrong: There isn't hardly any milk left.
mistakes.right: There is hardly any milk left.
mistakes.why: hardly zaten olumsuzdur, ikinci olumsuz almaz.

mistakes.wrong: He doesn't hardly ever call.
mistakes.right: He hardly ever calls.
mistakes.why: Aynı kural: tek olumsuzluk yeter.

mistakes.wrong: She seldom doesn't travel by car.
mistakes.right: She seldom travels by car.
mistakes.why: seldom olumsuzluğu kendi taşır.

exercises.text: There is ___ any bread left in the shop.

___ anyone came to the second meeting.

exercises.note: Cümle anlamca olumsuz olduğu için ek olumlu gelir.

exercises.text: We ___ had time to eat before the train left.
There were ___ any seats free in the hall.
Which sentence is correct? ___
The two brothers ___ speak to each other any more.

title: If it were not for — o olmasaydı
topic: if it were not for / if it hadn't been for
canDo: Bir şeyin varlığının her şeyi değiştirdiğini tek kalıpla anlatabilirim.

concept.summary: Bu kalıp tek bir etkenin belirleyici olduğunu söyler: "o olmasa, bambaşka olurdu". Bugüne bakan biçimi if it were not for, geçmişe bakan biçimi if it hadn't been for'dur. Zaman farkı kalıbın içinde taşınır: sonuç cümlesi buna uyar, bugün için would + fiil, geçmiş için would have + V3. Kalıptan sonra her zaman bir isim öbeği gelir, cümle gelmez.

formula.left: If it were not for + isim
formula.right: If it hadn't been for + isim

table.be: If it were not for X
table.example: If it were not for her, we would be lost.

table.be: If it hadn't been for X
table.example: If it hadn't been for the storm, …
… the project would stop.
… the ship would have arrived.

examples.en: If it were not for his support, the project would stop tomorrow.
examples.tr: Onun desteği olmasa proje yarın dururdu.

examples.en: If it hadn't been for the storm, the ship would have arrived on time.
If it were not for the noise, this would be a perfect flat.
examples.tr: Gürültü olmasa bu daire mükemmel olurdu.

examples.en: If it hadn't been for that letter, nobody would ever have known.
examples.tr: O mektup olmasaydı kimsenin haberi olmazdı.

examples.en: If it were not for the children, they would have separated years ago.
examples.note: Karma tip: bugünkü etken, geçmiş sonuç.

mistakes.wrong: If it wasn't for the storm, the ship would have arrived.
mistakes.right: If it hadn't been for the storm, the ship would have arrived.
mistakes.why: Geçmişteki etken için hadn't been kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: If it were not for she helped us, we would be lost.
mistakes.right: If it were not for her help, we would be lost.
mistakes.why: Kalıptan sonra isim öbeği gelir, cümle gelmez.

mistakes.wrong: If it were not for his support, the project stopped.
mistakes.right: If it were not for his support, the project would stop.
mistakes.why: Gerçek dışı koşulun sonucu would ile kurulur.

exercises.text: If it ___ not for the scholarship, she would leave the course.
If it ___ been for the neighbors, the fire would have spread.
If it were not for the rain, we ___ in the garden now.
If it hadn't been for his advice, I ___ the wrong flat.

If it hadn't been for the delay, we ___ the connection.
Which form points to the past? ___
options: If it is not for the fog …
If it will not be for the fog …
If it were not for the fog …
If it hadn't been for the fog …

title: Were it not for — en resmî devrik koşul
topic: Inverted were it not for / had it not been for
canDo: En resmî üslupta koşulu if kullanmadan kurabilirim.

concept.summary: Bir önceki dersin iki kalıbı, resmî yazıda if atılarak kurulur: Were it not for X ve Had it not been for X. Anlam tıpatıp aynıdır; değişen yalnızca üsluptur. Bu en resmî biçimdir ve yazıya özgüdür. if ile devrik biçim asla bir arada bulunmaz.

formula.left: If it were not for X

table.example: If it were not for the grant, …
Were it not for the grant, …
If it hadn't been for the storm, …
Had it not been for the storm, …

examples.en: Were it not for the scholarship, she couldn't have studied abroad.
Had it not been for the storm, the ship would have reached port.
Were it not for the language, I would apply for the post today.
examples.tr: Dil sorunu olmasa bugün o göreve başvururdum.

examples.en: Had it not been for one witness, the case would have collapsed.
examples.tr: Tek bir tanık olmasaydı dava çökerdi.

examples.en: Were it not for these two clauses, the contract would be acceptable.
examples.tr: Şu iki madde olmasa sözleşme kabul edilebilir olurdu.

mistakes.wrong: If had it not been for the storm, the ship would have arrived.
mistakes.right: Had it not been for the storm, the ship would have arrived.
mistakes.why: Devrik biçim if'in yerini alır.

mistakes.wrong: Were it not for the scholarship, she couldn't studied abroad.
mistakes.right: Were it not for the scholarship, she couldn't have studied abroad.
mistakes.why: Geçmiş sonuçta have + V3 gerekir.

mistakes.wrong: Was it not for the grant, we would stop.
mistakes.right: Were it not for the grant, we would stop.
mistakes.why: Bu kalıp her öznede were ister.

exercises.text: ___ it not for the new road, the village would be cut off.
___ it not been for the nurse, he would not have survived.
Were it not for the cost, we ___ the house.
Had it not been for the warning, the crash ___ .
Which sentence is written correctly? ___
options: If had it not been for you, I would have failed.
Had it not for you, I would have failed.
Had not it been for you, I would have failed.
Had it not been for you, I would have failed.
exercises.note: if kullanılmaz, been düşmez, not özneden sonra gelir.

exercises.text: Were it not for these ___ , the plan would go ahead.
___ it not been for the delay, we would have met her at the airport.
exercises.note: Geçmiş → Had it not been for.

exercises.text: ___ it not for the weather, this would be a perfect place to live.
In which text would you expect this structure? In ___ .
Had it not been for one signature, the deal ___ through.

title: If only I had — pişmanlığın en yoğun biçimi
canDo: Geçmişe dair pişmanlığımı en güçlü biçimde dile getirebilirim.

concept.summary: if only + past perfect, geçmişte yapılmamış bir şeye duyulan pişmanlığı anlatır ve I wish'ten daha yoğundur. Cümle çoğu zaman yarım bırakılır; sonuç söylenmeden de anlaşılır. Pişmanlık geçmişe bakıyorsa had + V3 gelir; bugüne bakıyorsa geçmiş biçim yeterlidir: If only I knew. would have bu kalıpta kullanılmaz.

table.example: If only I had listened.
If only I knew the answer.
If only he would stop talking.
not: If only I would have gone.

examples.en: If only I had taken that job.
If only we had known earlier.
If only she had asked before signing.
If only I knew where he was.
examples.note: Bugüne bakan istek: geçmiş biçim yeter.

examples.en: If only the phone would stop ringing.

mistakes.wrong: If only I would have listened.
mistakes.right: If only I had listened.
mistakes.why: Geçmişe dair pişmanlıkta had + V3 kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: If only I have taken that job.
mistakes.right: If only I had taken that job.
mistakes.why: Present perfect bu kalıpta yer almaz.

mistakes.wrong: If only I would know the answer.
mistakes.right: If only I knew the answer.
mistakes.why: Bugüne bakan istekte geçmiş biçim gelir.

exercises.text: If only I ___ the email before the meeting.
If only they ___ us that the road was closed.
If only I ___ how to say it in Turkish.
If only he ___ apologizing every five minutes.
If only we ___ the earlier flight.
Which sentence expresses regret about the past? ___
options: If only I would say no.
If only I had said no.

exercises.text: If only she ___ so quickly.
If only the tickets ___ cheaper.
If only I ___ him at the station that day.
If only somebody ___ something at the time.

title: will have been doing — gelecekte sürmüş olacak
canDo: Gelecekteki bir noktada bir işin ne kadar süredir sürüyor olacağını anlatabilirim.

concept.summary: Future perfect gelecekte biten işi anlatır; future perfect progressive ise gelecekteki bir noktada hâlâ süren ve o ana kadar ne kadar sürmüş olduğu sayılan işi anlatır. Neredeyse her zaman for + süre ile gelir. İşin bitip bitmediği önemli değildir, süresi önemlidir. Durum bildiren fiiller (know, be, own) bu biçimde kullanılmaz.

table.example: I will have been working here for ten years.
I will have finished the report.
By May, by then, by the time …
not: will have been knowing

examples.en: By next spring I will have been living here for five years.
examples.tr: Gelecek bahara burada beş yıldır yaşıyor olacağım.

examples.en: By then the team will have been testing the system for months.
examples.tr: O zamana kadar ekip sistemi aylardır test ediyor olacak.

examples.en: In June she will have been teaching for thirty years.
examples.tr: Haziranda otuz yıldır öğretmenlik yapıyor olacak.

examples.en: By the time you arrive, we will have been waiting for two hours.
examples.tr: Sen varana kadar iki saattir bekliyor olacağız.

examples.en: Next month they will have been married for forty years.
examples.tr: Gelecek ay kırk yıllık evli olacaklar.
examples.note: Durum bildiren anlamda düz perfect kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: By next spring I will be living here for five years.
mistakes.right: By next spring I will have been living here for five years.
mistakes.why: Süre gelecekteki bir noktaya kadar sayılıyorsa have been gerekir.

mistakes.wrong: By June I will have been knowing her for ten years.
mistakes.right: By June I will have known her for ten years.
mistakes.why: Durum bildiren fiiller sürerli biçime girmez.

mistakes.wrong: By then we will have been waiting since two hours.
mistakes.right: By then we will have been waiting for two hours.
mistakes.why: Süre uzunluğu for ile verilir.

exercises.text: By December they ___ on the bridge for three years.
By the time the film ends, we ___ for four hours.
In August I will have been ___ this car for ten years.
By next week she will have been studying ___ six months.
Which sentence counts the length of time? ___
options: By May I will have moved house.
By May I will move house.
By May I will have been living here for a year.
By May I am living here.
exercises.note: Süre sayan biçim have been + V-ing.

exercises.text: By June he ___ her for twenty years.
exercises.note: know durum fiilidir, sürerli biçime girmez.

exercises.text: By the end of the shift they ___ for eleven hours.
By then the machine ___ non-stop for two days.
Next year we ___ in this office for a decade.

title: Had you been waiting long? — öncesini sormak
canDo: Geçmişteki bir andan önce sürmekte olan bir işi sorgulayabilirim.

concept.summary: Geçmişte bir olay olduğunda, ondan önce süren işi sormak için had + özne + been + V-ing kullanılır. Soruda had başa gelir; do, does ya da did asla kullanılmaz. Bu biçim süreyi sorar, işin bitip bitmediğini değil. Cevap genellikle for ya da since ile verilir.

table.example: Had you been waiting long?
Hadn't they been working together?
How long had she been living there?
not: Did you have been waiting?

examples.en: Had you been waiting long when the train came?
examples.tr: Tren geldiğinde uzun süredir bekliyor muydun?

examples.en: Had they been arguing before you arrived?
How long had she been working there before the takeover?
examples.tr: Devralmadan önce orada ne zamandır çalışıyordu?

examples.en: Hadn't he been complaining about the noise for months?
Had it been raining all night, or did it start at dawn?
examples.tr: Bütün gece mi yağmıştı, yoksa şafakta mı başladı?

mistakes.wrong: Did you have been waiting long?
mistakes.right: Had you been waiting long?
mistakes.why: Past perfect sorusunda had başa gelir, do kullanılmaz.

mistakes.wrong: Had you been waited long?
mistakes.right: Had you been waiting long?
mistakes.why: been'den sonra -ing biçimi gelir.

mistakes.wrong: How long had she been working there since three years?
mistakes.right: How long had she been working there for three years?
mistakes.why: Süre uzunluğu for ile verilir.

exercises.text: ___ you been waiting long when I called?
Had they been ___ together before the merger?
How long ___ he been living abroad before he came back?
___ it been snowing all night?
Which question is correct? ___

___ the machine been making that noise before it stopped?

___ he been driving for six hours without a break?

title: Will you have finished? — o zamana kadar biter mi
canDo: Gelecekteki bir noktaya kadar bir işin tamamlanmış olup olmayacağını sorabilirim.

concept.summary: Gelecekteki bir noktaya kadar işin bitmiş olup olmayacağını sormak için will özneden öne alınır: Will you have finished by Monday? Soru neredeyse her zaman bir bitiş noktasıyla gelir. finish, complete, arrive gibi sonuç bildiren fiillerle sürerli biçim kullanılmaz; bu sorularda düz will have + V3 yeterlidir.

table.example: Will you have finished by six?
Won't they have left by then?
How much will we have paid by June?
Will the work have been done?

examples.en: Will you have finished the draft by Monday?
examples.tr: Taslağı pazartesiye kadar bitirmiş olur musun?

examples.en: Won't they have left the country by then?
examples.tr: O zamana kadar ülkeden ayrılmış olmazlar mı?

examples.en: How much will we have spent by the end of the year?
examples.tr: Yıl sonuna kadar ne kadar harcamış olacağız?

examples.en: Will the results have been published before the holiday?
examples.tr: Sonuçlar tatilden önce yayımlanmış olacak mı?

examples.en: Will she have heard about the change by tomorrow morning?
examples.tr: Yarın sabaha kadar değişiklikten haberi olmuş olur mu?

mistakes.wrong: Will you have been finished by Monday?
mistakes.right: Will you have finished by Monday?
mistakes.why: finish sonuç bildirir; burada süre biçimi gerekmez.

mistakes.wrong: Do you will have finished by Monday?
mistakes.right: Will you have finished by Monday?
mistakes.why: Soruda will özneden öne alınır, do kullanılmaz.

mistakes.wrong: Will you have finish by Monday?
mistakes.right: Will you have finished by Monday?
mistakes.why: have'den sonra üçüncü hâl gelir.

exercises.text: ___ they have arrived by seven?
Will you have ___ the forms before the deadline?
How much ___ we have paid back by next June?
___ the building have been finished by the autumn?
exercises.note: Edilgen soru → Will … have been + V3.

exercises.text: Which question about Friday is correct? ___
options: Will you have been read it by Friday?

Will you have read it by Friday?

exercises.text: ___ she have heard the news by the time we meet?

Will the team have ___ the work before the money runs out?

title: to have done — daha önce olmuş iş
canDo: Bir işin ana fiilden önce olduğunu mastar biçimiyle gösterebilirim.

concept.summary: Mastar, ana fiilden önce olmuş bir işi gösterecekse mükemmel biçime geçer: to have done. seem, appear, claim, be said gibi fiillerden sonra çok sık kullanılır ve iki cümleyi tek cümlede toplar. Düz mastar aynı anda ya da sonra olan işi gösterir; fark yalnızca have ile kurulur.

table.example: He seems to have left.
He seems to know.
It appears to have been moved.
She claims not to have seen it.

examples.en: She appears to have misunderstood the question.
He claims to have paid the bill in March.
The file seems to have been deleted by mistake.
She is said to have refused three offers.
He claims not to have known about the change.

mistakes.wrong: She appears to misunderstood the question.
mistakes.right: She appears to have misunderstood the question.
mistakes.why: Önce olmuş işte to have + V3 gerekir.

mistakes.wrong: He claims to have pay the bill.
mistakes.right: He claims to have paid the bill.
mistakes.why: have'den sonra üçüncü hâl gelir.

mistakes.wrong: She claims to not have seen it.
mistakes.right: She claims not to have seen it.
mistakes.why: Olumsuzda not, to'dan önce gelir.

exercises.text: He seems ___ the wrong bus.
exercises.note: Önce olmuş iş → to have + V3.

exercises.text: She is said ___ in three languages.
The letter appears ___ opened before it reached us.

He claims ___ anything about the meeting.
Which sentence puts the event before the main verb? ___
options: She seems to have read it.

exercises.text: The two firms are believed ___ before the sale.

She pretended ___ the question.

title: Having been rejected — iki cümleyi tek cümlede toplamak
canDo: Sırayı ve nedeni koruyarak iki cümleyi tek cümlede sıkıştırabilirim.

concept.summary: Having + V3 ile başlayan cümlecik, ana cümledeki işten önce bitmiş bir işi gösterir; edilgen anlamda having been + V3 olur. Akademik yazıda iki cümleyi tek cümlede toplamanın başlıca aracıdır. Kural: iki cümleciğin öznesi aynı olmalıdır; farklıysa cümle yanlış kişiye bağlanır ve anlam bozulur.

table.example: Having read the report, they postponed it.
Having been rejected twice, he stopped.
Being new, she asked a lot of questions.
not: Having read it, the room was quiet.

examples.en: Having been rejected twice, he stopped applying.
examples.tr: İki kez reddedildikten sonra başvurmayı bıraktı.

examples.en: Having read the report, the committee postponed the decision.
examples.tr: Komite raporu okuduktan sonra kararı erteledi.

examples.en: Having been warned about the road, we took the long way.
examples.tr: Yol konusunda uyarıldığımız için uzun yoldan gittik.

examples.en: Having lost the first game, the team played more carefully.
examples.tr: İlk maçı kaybettikten sonra takım daha dikkatli oynadı.

examples.en: Having been told nothing, the staff learned it from the news.
examples.tr: Kendilerine hiçbir şey söylenmediği için personel haberi gazeteden öğrendi.

mistakes.wrong: Being rejected twice, he stopped applying.
mistakes.right: Having been rejected twice, he stopped applying.
mistakes.why: İş ana fiilden önce bittiyse having been kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: Having read the report, the decision was postponed.
mistakes.right: Having read the report, the committee postponed the decision.
mistakes.why: İki cümleciğin öznesi aynı olmalı; raporu karar okumadı.

mistakes.wrong: Having been finish the work, we went home.
mistakes.right: Having finished the work, we went home.
mistakes.why: İşi biz yaptık: etken biçim gerekir.

exercises.text: ___ the letter, she put it in her pocket.
___ twice about the risk, they went ahead anyway.
Having ___ the exam, he took a week off.
___ nothing for two days, the children were very hungry.
Which sentence has the same subject in both parts? ___
options: Having checked the figures, it was signed.
Having checked the figures, the auditor signed the report.
Having checked the figures, the report was signed.
Having checked the figures, signing happened.
exercises.note: Rakamları denetçi denetledi, raporu da o imzaladı.

exercises.text: ___ from the list, she asked for an explanation.
Having ___ the money, they closed the account.
___ for the post, he waited three weeks for an answer.
___ so often, the story is now hard to check.
Having ___ the door, she realized she had no key.

title: so as to — amacı resmî biçimde bildirmek
topic: so as to / so as not to
canDo: Bir eylemin amacını resmî üslupta, özellikle olumsuz amaçlarda doğru kurabilirim.

concept.summary: so as to, in order to ile aynı işi görür ve düz to'dan daha resmîdir. Asıl değeri olumsuz amaçtadır: "-memek için" demek için so as not to kullanılır, çünkü düz mastar bu anlamı taşıyamaz. not her zaman to'dan önce gelir. Amaç bildiren yapının öznesi ana cümlenin öznesiyle aynıdır.

formula.right: so as not to + yalın fiil

table.example: He left early so as to avoid the traffic.
She spoke quietly so as not to wake him.
in order not to wake him
He left early to avoid the traffic.

examples.en: He left early so as to avoid the traffic.
She spoke quietly so as not to disturb anyone.
examples.tr: Kimseyi rahatsız etmemek için alçak sesle konuştu.

examples.en: The figures were rounded so as to simplify the table.
We took separate cars so as not to arrive together.
examples.tr: Birlikte varmamak için ayrı arabalarla gittik.

examples.en: He kept his voice flat so as to give nothing away.
examples.tr: Hiçbir şey belli etmemek için sesini düz tuttu.

mistakes.wrong: He left early so as to not miss the train.
mistakes.right: He left early so as not to miss the train.
mistakes.why: not, to'dan önce gelir.

mistakes.wrong: She spoke quietly so as she didn't wake him.
mistakes.right: She spoke quietly so as not to wake him.
mistakes.why: so as'tan sonra cümle değil mastar gelir.

mistakes.wrong: He left early so as avoid the traffic.
mistakes.right: He left early so as to avoid the traffic.
mistakes.why: so as ile fiil arasında to düşmez.

exercises.text: She took the back road so as ___ the roadworks.
He closed the door quietly so as ___ the baby.
exercises.note: Olumsuz amaç → so as not to.

exercises.text: The notes were shortened so as ___ the reader time.
We left in two groups so as ___ attention.
Which sentence puts not in the right place? ___
options: He whispered so as not being heard.
He whispered so as he was not heard.
He whispered so as to not be heard.
He whispered so as not to be heard.
exercises.note: so as not to + yalın fiil.

exercises.text: The meeting was moved so as ___ everyone to attend.
She wrote it down so as ___ it.
They arrived separately so as ___ suspicion.
exercises.note: so as not to + yalın fiil.

exercises.text: In which register does so as to belong? In ___ .
exercises.note: so as to, düz to'dan daha resmîdir.

exercises.text: The prices were fixed so as ___ small shops.

title: may as well — daha iyi seçenek yoksa
topic: may as well / might as well
canDo: Daha iyi bir seçenek olmadığı için alınan kararı doğal biçimde dile getirebilirim.

concept.summary: may as well ve might as well "bari, madem öyle" der: konuşmacı bu seçeneği coşkuyla değil, daha iyisi olmadığı için önerir. Arkasından her zaman yalın fiil gelir. İki biçim arasında anlam farkı yok denecek kadar azdır; might as well biraz daha yaygındır. Bu kalıp gönüllülük değil, kabullenme bildirir.

table.example: Nobody else is coming.
The bus is not running.
We might as well have stayed at home.
Bari yapalım.

examples.en: The train is delayed, so we may as well have a coffee.
examples.tr: Tren rötarlı, bari bir kahve içelim.

examples.en: Nobody else has come, so we might as well begin.
If you are going that way, you may as well take the parcel.
examples.tr: Madem o tarafa gidiyorsun, bari paketi de götür.

examples.en: We might as well have stayed at home for all the good it did.
examples.tr: Bu kadar faydası olduysa bari evde kalsaydık.
examples.note: Geçmiş için: might as well have + V3.

examples.en: The shop shuts in ten minutes; I may as well wait until tomorrow.
examples.tr: Dükkân on dakikaya kapanıyor; bari yarına kadar bekleyeyim.

mistakes.wrong: We may as well to start now.
mistakes.right: We may as well start now.
mistakes.why: Kalıptan sonra yalın fiil gelir.

mistakes.wrong: We may as well starting now.
mistakes.right: We may as well start now.
mistakes.why: -ing biçimi bu kalıpta kullanılmaz.

mistakes.wrong: We may as well stayed at home.
mistakes.right: We might as well have stayed at home.
mistakes.why: Geçmişe bakan kullanımda have + V3 gerekir.

exercises.text: The last bus has gone, so we may as well ___ .
Nobody is answering; you might as well ___ a message.
We ___ as well tell her the truth now.
The meeting is over, so I might as well ___ home.
What does may as well express? It expresses ___ .
Since you are up, you may as well ___ the kettle on.
We might as well ___ the tickets last week; the concert is sold out.
It is raining anyway, so we might as well ___ inside.
Nobody reads the second page, so we may as well ___ it.
The file is open; you may as well ___ the change now.

title: ought not to — kurala dayalı tavsiye
canDo: Tavsiyeyi kişisel görüşten çok kurala dayandırarak, olumsuz ve soru biçimlerinde kurabilirim.

concept.summary: ought to should ile aynı anlamdadır ama biraz daha nesnel durur: konuşmacı kendi görüşünü değil, dışarıdaki bir kuralı ya da genel kabulü işaret eder. Olumsuzu ought not to olur ve to düşmez; bu, İngilizcedeki tek kip artığıdır ve en sık yapılan yanlış tam burada olur. Olumsuz soru biçimi Ought you not to …? çok resmîdir; günlük dilde yerini Shouldn't you …? alır.

table.example: You ought to check the terms.
You ought not to worry.
They ought not to have published it.
Ought we not to ask first?

examples.en: You ought to check the terms before signing.
They ought not to have published those figures.
You ought not to worry about a form that nobody reads.
examples.tr: Kimsenin okumadığı bir form için endişelenmemelisin.

examples.en: Ought we not to ask the owner first?
Shouldn't we ask the owner first?

mistakes.wrong: You oughtn't worry about it.
mistakes.right: You ought not to worry about it.
mistakes.why: ought'un olumsuzunda to korunur.

mistakes.wrong: You ought not to published those figures.
mistakes.right: You ought not to have published those figures.
mistakes.why: Geçmişe dair eleştiride have + V3 gerekir.

mistakes.wrong: Do you ought to ask first?
mistakes.right: Ought you to ask first?
mistakes.why: ought bir kiptir; soruda do kullanılmaz.

exercises.text: You ought ___ to leave the door unlocked.
They ought not to ___ the results before the check.
___ we not to warn them first?
exercises.note: Resmî olumsuz soru → Ought we not to …?

exercises.text: You ought not ___ sign anything today.
Which is the everyday form of "Ought you not to tell her?" It is ___ .
options: Don't you ought to tell her?
Ought not you to tell her?

exercises.text: He ought ___ to have taken the car without asking.
___ the committee not to have seen the letter first?
We ought not to ___ so long before answering.
Why is ought to used instead of should? Because it sounds ___ .
options: more objective, based on a rule
exercises.note: ought to kurala dayalı ton taşır.

exercises.text: You ought not to ___ about it in front of the staff.

title: dare — cesaret etmenin iki çekimi
canDo: dare fiilini hem kip hem gerçek fiil olarak doğru çekebilirim.

concept.summary: dare düz cümlede de iki türlü çekilir. Gerçek fiil gibi çekilirse do/does/did alır ve arkasından to gelir: He didn't dare to say anything. Kip gibi çekilirse yardımcı fiil almaz, olumsuzu daren't olur ve arkasından yalın fiil gelir: He daren't say anything. Kip çekimi bugün çoğunlukla olumsuz cümlede kalmıştır; olumlu kip çekimi (I dare say) kalıplaşmıştır.

table.example: He didn't dare to contradict her.
He daren't contradict her.
I dare say you are right.
She dared not look up.

examples.en: He didn't dare to contradict his manager.
I daren't tell her what the doctor said.
examples.tr: Doktorun ne dediğini ona söylemeye cesaret edemiyorum.

examples.en: She dared not look at the results.
I dare say the price will go up again.
Nobody dared to ask what the delay had cost.
examples.tr: Gecikmenin neye mal olduğunu kimse sormaya cesaret edemedi.

mistakes.wrong: He didn't dare contradicting his manager.
mistakes.right: He didn't dare to contradict his manager.
mistakes.why: Gerçek fiil olarak çekilince to'lu biçim gelir.

mistakes.wrong: I daren't to tell her.
mistakes.right: I daren't tell her.
mistakes.why: Kip çekiminde to gelmez.

mistakes.wrong: She didn't dared to look up.
mistakes.right: She didn't dare to look up.
mistakes.why: Geçmişlik did'e geçtiği için dare yalın kalır.

exercises.text: He didn't dare ___ anything in front of the others.
I ___ tell him what really happened.
She dared not ___ at the examiner.
Nobody dared ___ the manager about the missing file.
I ___ say you have heard this before.
They didn't ___ to complain about the noise.
He ___ go back to the house alone.
She did not dare ___ the subject again.
Which sentence treats dare as a modal? ___
options: He did not dare to speak.
exercises.note: Kip çekiminde yardımcı fiil ve to yoktur.

exercises.text: The children dared not ___ a sound.

title: Couldn't you have …? — sitem sorusu
canDo: Bir şeyin neden yapılmadığını, suçlamadan ama sitemi belli ederek sorabilirim.

concept.summary: could ile kurulan olumsuz soru bilgi istemez; yapılabilecekken yapılmamış bir şeye sitem bildirir. Geçmişe bakıyorsa couldn't … have + V3 biçimini alır. Ton önemlidir: aynı cümle yumuşak bir serzeniş de olabilir, sert bir suçlama da. Bu yüzden resmî yazışmada değil, konuşmada ve kişisel yazışmada geçer.

table.example: Couldn't you have told me?
Can't you just call her?
Couldn't you stay a little longer?
Rapora yazılmaz.

examples.en: Couldn't you have told me earlier?
Couldn't they have warned the neighbors first?
Couldn't you stay until Sunday?
Couldn't we have done this last week?
Can't you just send her a message?
examples.tr: Ona bir mesaj atsan olmaz mı?

mistakes.wrong: Couldn't you told me earlier?
mistakes.right: Couldn't you have told me earlier?
mistakes.why: Geçmişe bakan sitemde have + V3 gerekir.

mistakes.wrong: Couldn't you have tell me earlier?
mistakes.right: Couldn't you have told me earlier?
mistakes.why: have'den sonra üçüncü hâl gelir.

mistakes.wrong: Don't you could have told me?
mistakes.right: Couldn't you have told me?
mistakes.why: Kip sorusunda do kullanılmaz.

exercises.text: ___ you have said something at the meeting?

title: the other, others, the others
canDo: Bir grubun parçalarına karışıklığa yer bırakmadan gönderme yapabilirim.

concept.summary: Belirlilik bu kelimede her şeyi değiştirir. the other geriye kalan tek şeydir; others belirsiz "başkaları"dır; the others belirli bir grubun geri kalanının tamamıdır. another ise "bir tane daha" demektir ve tekildir. Seçerken tek soru şu: grup belli mi ve geriye kaç şey kalıyor?

table.example: one is a doctor, the other is a pilot
some agreed; others did not
three stayed; the others left
do you have another?

examples.en: I have two brothers: one is a doctor, the other is a pilot.
examples.tr: İki erkek kardeşim var: biri doktor, diğeri pilot.
examples.note: Geriye tek kişi kaldı → the other.

examples.en: Some people welcomed the plan; others opposed it.
examples.tr: Bazıları planı olumlu karşıladı, başkaları karşı çıktı.

examples.en: Three of us stayed; the others went home.
This one is broken; do you have another?
We should consider the views of others.

mistakes.wrong: One is red, another is blue, and that is all of them.
mistakes.right: One is red, the other is blue.
mistakes.why: İkiden biri kaldıysa belirlidir.

mistakes.wrong: Two stayed; others left, all of them.
mistakes.right: Two stayed; the others left.
mistakes.why: Kalanların tamamı kastediliyorsa the others.

mistakes.wrong: Some agreed; the others did not, but we do not know who.
mistakes.right: Some agreed; others did not.
mistakes.why: Grup belirsizse the kullanılmaz.
